title: Rabbi Anani bar Sasson

paragraphs: Rabbi Anani bar Sasson. (Anani—1 Chronicles 3:24.) Moed Katan 24b mentions him expounding at the Nasi’s doorway. Rabbi Ami heard and objected: “Is it his own teaching? It is Rabbi Elazar’s in Rabbi Oshaya’s name!”
And in Shabbat 64b he said in the name of Rabbi Yishmael [in accord with Rabbi Yose]: everything is like a kavul. And see the Yerushalmi there, ch. 6, end of halakhah 1.

He is also mentioned in Zevachim 88b: he said, 'Like the dispute here,' etc., and likewise there he expounded why the section on sacrifices was juxtaposed to the section on the priestly garments, etc.

notes.text: The checked Moed Katan text explicitly names Rabbi Elazar. The Shabbat parallel names Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yose; Hyman’s bracketed [כר׳ יוסי] is preserved as his supplied wording.

The consulted Moed Katan 24b explicitly names Elazar in Oshaya’s name. Shabbat 64b first has Yishmael and then Yishmael son of Yose; Hyman’s bracketed “in accord with Rabbi Yose” is kept separately rather than silently rewritten.
